summary: Coffee Swamp is a two-acre freshwater swamp on the northern edge of Washington Island in Door County, Wisconsin. It has been a designated state natural area since 1994. The swamp represents a boreal forest and hosts plant species including various sedges, ferns and other rare plants.
one_line: Coffee Swamp is a two-acre boreal freshwater swamp on Washington Island, Wisconsin, designated a state natural area in 1994.
